summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing definitive agreements with Orion Mine Finance funds to acquire five precious-metals streams and royalties for US$290 million, comprising US$200 million cash and US$90 million equity. Concurrently, a non-binding deal with Carlin East divests the Generation Business for a cornerstone equity stake. CEO David M. Cole resigned effective immediately, replaced by Frederick Bell. The acquisition is expected to be NAV- and revenue-per-share accretive, adding Ruby Hill and Kouroussa. Watch equity issuance dilution, financing, and Carlin East deal finalization.
